name: Compare and Contrast Essay
purpose: Explains two subjects by showing how they resemble and differ from each other on the same points.

components.note: Names both subjects and the basis of comparison, not just 'X and Y are similar and different.'
Carries extra weight here — it's what signals the shift between subjects or points (similarly, in contrast, whereas).
States why the comparison matters, not just a recap of what was compared.

organizational_patterns.name: Block (Subject-by-Subject)
organizational_patterns.description: Covers all points for subject A, then all the same points for subject B.

organizational_patterns.name: Point-by-Point
organizational_patterns.description: Alternates A and B within each point of comparison before moving to the next point.

pitfalls: Comparing on inconsistent points across the two subjects (apples to oranges within the essay itself).
Ending without saying why the comparison is worth having made.
Block structure so long the reader has forgotten subject A's details by the time subject B arrives — point-by-point usually reads better past a couple of comparison points.
